_help: Mission for the FUTURE 3D simulator (ACADEMY_SPEC H, step 22; docs/academy_sim_interface.md). runs_on sim: the boat is always the simulated AURIX (autopilot_sim on 127.0.0.1:5760); the 3D world only SHOWS it and scores the goals. world = the terrain area (data/sim3d/terrain/<world>/, drone photos for the view only - never a chart). goals use metres from the start position (n_m north, e_m east): reach / keep_clear (radius_m), heading (deg, tol_deg), mode (a mode name), time_limit (s). pass_score 1..100; max_attempts 0 = no limit. lesson = the simulator lesson whose own checks run too (optional). Edit freely; academy/test_academy.py AC45 checks every file.
brief_el: Επιστρέψτε στη ράμπα με χαμηλή ταχύτητα, κρατήστε απόσταση από τον μώλο και σταματήστε στο σημείο της ράμπας σε STANDBY.
brief_en: Return to the ramp at low speed, keep clear of the jetty and stop at the ramp point in STANDBY.
